prep.notes:
1. Filtered YouBike stations to keep only those within 800 meters of MRT Daan Station (25.0330, 121.5436) using prep.within_radius.
2. Cleaned coordinates using prep.drop_stray_points to remove any invalid GPS data.
3. Merged stations that share the same name and are very close together using prep.merge_same_place to ensure one entity per real place.
4. Reduced the number of sites to a maximum of 60 using prep.reduce_points to ensure the problem size fits the solver's performance constraints.
5. Generated a distance matrix using prep.haversine_matrix for all selected stations.
6. Created a mock 'positions' set as a sequence of IDs (P0, P1, ...) to represent the tour order.
